original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥孙州尼日利亚劳工大会罢工致学校、医院和政府机构停摆
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州劳工大会发起为期三天的罢工，抗议地方政府拨款被扣留。罢工导致政府办公楼、公立中小学和医院关闭，州政府秘书处及高等法院也停止办公。部分试图上班的工人被工会人员劝返。目前该消息为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 奥孙州劳工大会开始为期三天的罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Osun State NLC has begun a three-day strike, shutting down government offices, schools, and hospitals over withheld local government allocations.

key_facts.fact: 州政府秘书处周一未开门办公
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Osun State Government Secretariat and other government establishments in the state did not open for business on Monday

key_facts.fact: 公立中小学全部停课，高等法院停止办公
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: all public primary and secondary schools were shut. Also, the entrance to the premises of Osun State High Court at Okefia, Osogbo, was shut to business

key_facts.fact: 部分试图上班的工人被疑似工会人员劝返
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some workers who attempted to report at the Government Secretariat, Abere, were turned back by people believed to be officials of the labour unions in the state.

uncertainties: 罢工起因所称地方政府拨款被扣留一事未获其他来源证实
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
劝返上班工人者身份仅为推测（据信为工会人员）
